paragraphs: Box sells intelligent content management, secure collaboration and workflow software. The pitch starts from unstructured data, things like sales presentations, product specs and employee handbooks, sitting at the center of how people work. Teams access, share, edit and co-create that content together.

Box AI taps models from OpenAI, Anthropic and Google for summaries, analysis and recommendations. Extraction tools pull structured data from contracts, bank statements and handwritten bills of lading. A drag-and-drop builder is used to design and deploy workflows. E-signature sits with the content, so users stop jumping from email to separate signing apps. Security features include malware detection and alerts about unusual activity. Built-in compliance tools address requirements such as GDPR, HIPAA and FINRA.

The site groups customers by sector, including state and local government. It counts more than 1,500 app integrations on one platform. Box Zones has expanded to 10 regions, adding Switzerland, Singapore and Israel. A customer quoted on the page is a CDO at Morgan Stanley Wealth Management. Chief executive Aaron Levie is listed as taking the stage at the company's BoxWorks event in San Francisco.

quote.text: Sales presentations, product specs, employee handbooks: Unstructured data is at the center of how you work.
